Admissions
Thank you for your interest in the graduate programs in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics, to which applicatons for admission must be done ONLINE through the website of the UNC Charlotte graduate school at
UNC Charlotte Graduate School Admissions
Please explore the admissions webpages for details on the application and admission processes. Additional admission requirements can be found from the graduate catalog as well as from the department’s website.
Application deadlines: Complete applications received by the following priority deadlines will receive full consideration for admission. Applications that become complete after the priority deadlines but before the final application deadlines are considered on a space-available basis. Also, if you wish to be considered for teaching assistantship, the deadline for Fall admissions is March 1st.
Priority application deadlines:
Summer: April 1st
Fall: March 1st
Spring: October 1st
Final application deadlines:
Summer: June 15th
Fall: August 1st (June 1st for applicants living outside the U.S. who require a F or J visa; July 1st for applicants living inside the U.S. who require a F or J visa)
Spring: December 1st
Fall Admission Timeline: The department’s graduate recruitment committee will begin reviewing applications completed by March 1st in early March, and admission decisions can be expected around March 20th.
